access.title: Access and permissions
access.description: What each role may do, and how far it may see into classified data. This is the policy the API enforces right now.
access.separation: Separation of duties: system administrators configure the platform but cannot approve mappings or resolve HR conflicts.
access.clearanceDescription: The highest classification each role may see on a record, by the entity the record belongs to. Another entity's fields also need an active transfer entry.
access.clearanceCaption: Highest classification each role may see, by the record's entity
access.adminNote: Changing permissions and clearance arrives with access administration. Every change will be audited.

classification.title: Data classification
classification.description: Every classified field, with its level and why. Masking and the transfer register follow this register.
classification.caption: Classified fields
classification.sensitiveNote: Sensitive means sensitive personal information under PIPL, such as financial accounts.

empty.title: No field is classified yet
empty.description: A field is classified before it can be masked, mapped or shared.

classification.visibleUnknown: Not available: the access policy did not load
classification.transferNote: A field of another entity's records also needs an active transfer entry before it reaches you.

transfers.title: Cross-border transfer register
transfers.description: Each flow of personal data between entities, with its legal basis and approval. Only active entries share fields; everything else is withheld.
transfers.noFields: None of its categories names a known field, so it shares nothing.

empty.title: No transfer is registered
empty.description: Until an entry is approved, no entity receives another entity's employee data.

changeDialog.title: Change the status of {{name}}
changeDialog.description: Approving shares the entry's fields with the destination on the next request. Suspending or expiring it withholds them at once. The change and its reason are audited.
changeDialog.reasonHint: Recorded in the audit log with your name.
changeDialog.reasonRequired: Give a reason for the change.
changeDialog.willShare: {{to}} will receive these fields on its next request:
changeDialog.willWithhold: {{to}} stops receiving these fields at once:
changeDialog.sharesNothing: Nothing is shared before or after this change.

retention.title: Retention
retention.description: How long each kind of data is kept, and what happens to it then.
retention.caption: Retention rules
retention.purgeNote: Nothing is purged yet: the scheduled purge arrives with retention administration, and will record what each run did.

empty.title: No retention rule is set
empty.description: Until one is, data is kept with no end date.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Every change and sign-in, newest first: who did what to which record, and which fields changed. The values stay behind each record's masking rules.

filters.label: Filter the audit log
filters.toBeforeFrom: The end date must be on or after the start date.

empty.title: No event matches these filters
empty.description: Widen the dates or clear a filter.

chain.title: Integrity
chain.description: Each event stores the hash of the one before it, so an edited or deleted event breaks the chain. The database also refuses changes to the log.
chain.broken: Broken at event {{id}}: an event was changed or removed after it was written. Report it to the data protection officer.
